name: speed
title: Hooks and commands on a real archive
summary: How long an agent session waits for ctx. Hooks run on every session start, compaction and subagent start, so they are held to a 3-second limit and should take a small fraction of it.

meaning: At the median every hook takes under 50 ms, far inside its limit. The run failed its bar because one compaction brief took 1.2 s on a machine running at three times its capacity; the slowest runs are the ones to watch.
